plain_interface_subset.copy: Exact plain field/type declarations; whitespace adapted. The separate native client index declares the matching keyed SlotMap type subset. The stock Models client remains its runtime declarer; no Models package dependency added.

native_slot.readiness: Generic keyConfigured is ignored. Actual owner status and qualified entry readiness come from the injected Prime provider controller.

model_candidate.verification: Primary reference verified by B on 2026-10-01; presented as a local draft candidate, not runtime route qualification.

scope: Owned additive native provider-card component. No frozen face, stock Models editor, generic credential/settings route, inference request, or compiled bundle changed. Key input is uncontrolled and disabled until the controller reports owner status loaded and an approved entry ready.
